app.name: Social Connect
app.tagline: All your content, in one place
onboarding.subtitle: Pick the topics you care about: your feed will be ready in seconds. No account required.
home.platforms.hint: Click a logo to select it, then click another logo (or use ◀ ▶) to move it before or after. Platforms at the front get priority in your content.
sort.select: Click a logo to select it
refresh.title: Refresh content
settings.sysnotif.desc: Get a real device notification when news arrives from your sources, topics and interests. Personal app notifications (mentions, messages...) will come with the native Android app.
settings.sysnotif.denied: Permission denied by the browser: enable it in the site settings
sysnotif.body: new items from your sources and interests
notif.title: Notification center
notif.empty: Nothing new for now. Check back later!
settings.title: Settings
settings.applock.desc: Protect access with fingerprint or face (device passkey)
settings.applock.unsupported: Your browser does not support biometric authentication (WebAuthn)
settings.accounts.desc: You sign in securely on each platform's official site and the browser keeps the session open. Track your logins and sign out from here. Full OAuth linking (personal feeds) is coming in a future update.
interests.title: My interests
interests.desc: Add a name — a team, an artist, a topic — and Social Connect will surface dedicated content, notifications and the social profiles to connect.
interests.limit: You reached the maximum number of interests
settings.about: Social Connect — MVP version. Content is provided by the respective sources and platforms. Trademarks belong to their respective owners.
lock.title: Social Connect is locked
lock.subtitle: Use your fingerprint or face to continue
feed.offline: You are offline: showing last update
feed.empty: No content in this category. Try adding sources from settings.
